56.name: Boko Highway Tyre and Puncture
56.description: Roadside truck tyre mechanic next to a dhaba on NH-17 near Boko. Comes out to the highway.

71.name: PM RAHAT: cashless accident treatment
71.description: Central scheme for cashless treatment of road-accident victims, linked to 112. A police report is part of the claim. Ask the hospital whether it applies.

72.name: Assam Golden Hour scheme
72.description: State scheme for cashless trauma care after a road accident. Ask the hospital whether it is covered.

61.name: NHAI Highway Helpline 1033
61.description: National highway helpline. It passes your call to the team that clears the highway.

11.description: Free emergency ambulance anywhere in Assam. This pin is symbolic.
